market.title: Will Enes Kanter Freedom Be Drafted in the 2027 WNBA Draft?
resolutionNote: Polymarket's own wording: "This market will resolve to 'Yes' if Enes Kanter Freedom is drafted in the 2027 WNBA Draft. Otherwise, this market will resolve to 'No.'"
If the 2027 WNBA Draft is cancelled, postponed past May 1, 2027, or the result can't be confirmed by then, this resolves No.
Resolution source is official WNBA/team announcements, or a consensus of credible reporting if those aren't available.
No matching Kalshi market currently exists for this question, so this page is Polymarket-only.

text: Enes Kanter Freedom, a 34-year-old former NBA center who played 11 seasons in the league, declared his eligibility for the 2027 WNBA Draft in early August 2026.

He's framed it as a test of the WNBA's own eligibility rules rather than a competitive bid, saying: "If simply declaring who you are is all that's required, then I meet every single requirement necessary to compete in the WNBA."
The WNBA hasn't confirmed his eligibility either way, and the WNBPA (the players' union) pushed back, saying it won't be "used as political pawns."
Prediction markets have it as a heavy longshot - Polymarket prices Yes at around 7-8%, with no Kalshi market currently listed for this one.
